fr_renouveler_verb.why: Nouveau = new → renouveler = to renew, to replace with new. Regular -er (je renouvelle): RED beret.
ex: Il renouvelle les fleurs du vase.
He puts fresh flowers in the vase.

fr_substituer_verb.why: Substitute → substituer = to substitute, to swap in. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_ameliorer_verb.why: a-MAIL-iorer: improving the mailbox → améliorer = to improve, to make better. Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Il améliore le nichoir.
He improves the birdhouse.

fr_vieillir_verb.why: YAY + YEAR → vieillir = to grow old, to age. Regular -ir (nous vieillissons): GREEN beret.
ex: Avec sa barbe blanche, il fait semblant de vieillir.
With his white beard, he pretends to grow old.

fr_modifier_verb.why: Modify → modifier = to modify, to change. Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Il modifie sa petite voiture.
He modifies his little car.

fr_compenser_verb.why: Compensate → compenser = to make up for, to compensate. Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Il ajoute un poids pour compenser.
He adds a weight to make up for it.

fr_abaisser_verb.why: A-B-C → abaisser = to lower, to bring down. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_renforcer_verb.why: Reinforce → renforcer = to strengthen, to reinforce. Regular -er (nous renforçons): RED beret.

fr_croitre_verb.why: Croître = to grow, to increase (croissance, crescent). Irregular (il croît, crû): GOLD beret.

fr_refroidir_verb.why: Froid = cold → refroidir = to cool (down). Regular -ir (nous …issons): GREEN beret.
ex: Il souffle pour refroidir le gâteau.
He blows to cool the cake down.

fr_rabattre_verb.why: Battre = to beat → rabattre = to fold down, to pull down, to shut (a lid). Irregular like battre (je rabats): GOLD beret.

fr_hausser_verb.why: Haut = high → hausser = to raise; hausser les épaules = to shrug. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_accroitre_verb.why: Accrue, increase → accroître = to increase, to grow. Irregular like croître: GOLD beret.
ex: Il accroît sa pyramide de pommes.
He makes his apple pyramid bigger.

fr_redoubler_verb.why: Double → redoubler = to redouble, to intensify; also to repeat a school year. Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Il redouble d'efforts pour tirer la corde.
He pulls the rope twice as hard.

fr_agrandir_verb.why: Grand = big → agrandir = to enlarge, to make bigger. Regular -ir (nous …issons): GREEN beret.
ex: La loupe agrandit la coccinelle.
The magnifying glass makes the ladybird look bigger.

fr_elargir_verb.why: Large = wide → élargir = to widen. Regular -ir (nous …issons): GREEN beret.
ex: Il élargit le petit chemin.
He widens the little path.

fr_grossir_verb.why: GROSS, ever-growing garbage pile → grossir = to get bigger, to put on weight. Regular -ir (nous grossissons): GREEN beret.
ex: La boule de neige grossit.
The snowball gets bigger.

fr_reviser_verb.why: Revise → réviser = to revise, to review; also to service (a car). Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_moderniser_verb.why: Modernize → moderniser = to modernize. Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Il modernise sa vieille lampe.
He modernizes his old lamp.

fr_innover_verb.why: Innovate → innover = to innovate. Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Avec sa machine, il innove.
With his machine, he innovates.

fr_revolutionner_verb.why: Revolution → révolutionner = to revolutionize. Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: La roue a révolutionné le transport.
The wheel revolutionized transport.

fr_raffiner_verb.why: Refine → raffiner = to refine. Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Il raffine le sucre.
He refines the sugar.

fr_personnaliser_verb.why: Personalize → personnaliser = to personalize, to customize. Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Il personnalise son arrosoir.
He personalizes his watering can.

fr_renover_verb.why: Renovate → rénover = to renovate, to restore. Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Il rénove le vieux mur.
He renovates the old wall.

fr_retraiter_verb.why: Traiter = to treat, to process → retraiter = to reprocess, to recycle. Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: On retraite le verre de ces bouteilles.
The glass from these bottles is reprocessed.

fr_alterner_verb.why: Alternate → alterner = to alternate. Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Il alterne fleurs rouges et fleurs blanches.
He alternates red flowers and white flowers.

fr_alterer_verb.why: Alter (for the worse) → altérer = to spoil, to damage, to alter. Regular -er (j'altère): RED beret.
ex: La pluie altère son dessin à la craie.
The rain spoils his chalk drawing.

fr_ternir_verb.why: Terne = dull → ternir = to tarnish, to dull. Regular -ir (nous …issons): GREEN beret.
ex: L'humidité ternit la théière en argent.
Damp tarnishes the silver teapot.
